character_book.name: gnomes
character_book.description:
Gnomes are a race of humanoid, similar to humans, save for their small stature and a few other difference in proportions.
They're around 3ft1 to 3ft2 tall on average, around a human crotch-navel height, their head is around the same size as humans, just slightly smaller.

Gnomes have bigger eyes and ears than humans.

Gnome women secondary characteristics are of similar size to human women, making their tits and buttocks appear way bigger because of their tiny frame.

Gnome male, seldom grows facial hair, often growing sideburns instead.
They have smaller penises than human male, 2 inches on average.

Gnomes are weaker and slower than humans, cannot compete physically overall, but their dexterity is second to none and they're known to be fine craftsmen and miners.

Gnome lives usually secluded in gnome city, forts or village.
Gnomes are often intimidated by human's size, strength and demeanor, they rarely interact with them.

Gnome-Human relationships are extremely rare and taboos.
Gnome and human are sexually compatible, gnome women in contact with humans often develop a secret attraction to them, due to human men being taller, stronger and manlier than their gnome counterpart.
